current.title: Ghar Jamai Ka Raaz
current.logline: Sabko lagta hai woh ek bekaar 'ghar jamai' hai jo biwi ke paiso par palta hai, lekin asliyat mein woh ek global tech mogul hai. Jab uski biwi ka parivaar usey baar-baar zaleel karta hai, toh woh din dur nahi jab unka ghamand Veer ke ek ishare par toot jayega.
current.characters: Veer: Hero, seemingly jobless 'ghar jamai', secretly CEO of 'Horizon Tech' (a global AI/Space tech firm). Wants: A simple life, for Rhea to love him for himself, to discreetly help her dreams. Rhea: Heroine, ambitious boutique owner, struggles with family pressure about Veer. Wants: To make her business successful, protect Veer from taunts. Tina: Antagonist, Rhea's materialistic sister. Wants: To maintain social superiority, humiliate Rhea and Veer. Sameer: Antagonist, Tina's flashy but secretly struggling husband. Wants: To impress society, dominate Rhea's family.
arc: Part 1: Ghar ke dining table par, Tina aur Sameer baar-baar Veer ko uski 'joblessness' ke liye taane mar rahe hain. 'Tum toh bas Rhea ki kamai par palte ho!' Tina ne hans kar kaha. Veer bas apni coffee ka cup ghoor raha hai, lekin uske phone par 'Horizon Tech' ka logo chamka aur ek message aaya: 'Sir, 'Lunar Project' deal closed, 500 Billion USD.' Veer ne phone discreetly apni jeb mein daal liya. Rhea, apni struggling boutique ke liye loan application reject hone se dukhi, ghar aayi. Tina ne fauran taana maara, 'Dekha Rhea, tumhara bekaar pati kisi kaam ka nahi, aur tumhari boutique bhi doob rahi hai!' Veer ne apna cup neeche rakha, 'Rhea, agar tum chaho toh main help kar sakta hoon.' Tina zor se has padi, 'Tum? Tum toh khud Rhea ke paiso par palte ho!' Veer ka phone phir vibrate hua, screen par flash hua: 'Breaking News: Horizon Tech acquires StarNet Global, deal worth 1 Trillion USD.'

Part 2: Rhea apni boutique ke liye nayi designs bana rahi hai, lekin paise ki kami ki wajah se woh kisi bade event mein participate nahi kar pa rahi. Tina aur Sameer, jo ek bade corporate event mein ja rahe hain, Rhea ko taana marte hain, 'Tumhari aukat nahi hai wahan jaane ki, Rhea.' Veer, apni jeans ki jeb mein haath daal kar, chupchap kuch calls karta hai. Agle din, Rhea ko ek unexpected email aata hai: 'Invitation to the 'Global Design Summit' – Special Entry.' Tina ki aankhen phati reh gayi. Event mein, Rhea apni designs present kar rahi hai, jab Tina 'galti se' uske design sheets par juice gira deti hai. Rhea ghabra jaati hai. Veer uske paas aata hai, 'Relax, Rhea. Yeh toh bas warm-up tha.' Veer ek button press karta hai, aur ek hidden screen par Rhea ke original designs ka 3D holographic projection shuru ho jaata hai. Poora hall taaliyon se goonj uthta hai. Tabhi, event ka sabse bada investor, Mr. Malhotra, Veer ke paas aata hai aur jhuk kar kehta hai, 'Sir, aapne bulaya?'

Part 3: Mr. Malhotra ki help se Rhea ko ek huge order mil jaata hai, uski boutique ki fortunes palat jaati hain. Tina aur Sameer jealousy mein pagal ho jaate hain. Sameer, apni girti hui company ko bachane ke liye, Rhea ke new client ko blackmail karne ki koshish karta hai taaki woh contract cancel kar dein. Veer ko yeh sab pata chal jaata hai. Dinner table par, Sameer apni 'jeep' ka ghamand karta hai, 'Maine Rhea ko bachaya, uske client ko samjha diya ki woh galat company choose kar rahe hain. Ab dekhte hain uska business kaise chalta hai!' Rhea sun kar shocked reh jaati hai. Veer bas uski taraf dekhta hai, ek halki muskurahat ke saath. Tabhi Sameer ka phone zor se bajta hai. Dusri taraf se ek ghabrayi hui awaaz aati hai, 'Sir, humari 'Mega-City Project' deal cancel ho gayi! Woh client seedha humari company ke board members tak pahunch gaya hai, keh raha hai aapne 'illegal' attempt kiya... aur usne humare saare investors ko bhi inform kar diya!' Sameer ke haath se phone chhoot jaata hai. 'Yeh... yeh kaise ho sakta hai?' Veer uske paas se guzarta hai, casually apna phone check karte hue, 'Kabhi kabhi, galat logon se panga lena mehenga pad jaata hai.'

Part 4: Sameer ki company ekdum se doobne lagti hai, investors peeche hat rahe hain. Tina gusse mein paagal hai, Veer ko 'jadoo-tona' karne ka ilzaam lagati hai. Rhea ki boutique ki har taraf charcha ho rahi hai. Ek family function mein, Tina aur Sameer, Rhea aur Veer ko sabke saamne gher lete hain. 'Tumne humare saath kya kiya, Veer? Tum toh ek bekaar ghar jamai ho!' Tina chillaati hai. Veer shaanti se khada rehta hai. Sameer aage badhta hai, 'Tumhari himmat kaise hui hamare business ko touch karne ki! Tumhari aukat kya hai!' Veer ka phone ring karta hai. Woh pick karta hai, 'Yes, Mr. Sharma, the board meeting is at 10 AM. Main time par pahunch jaunga.' Tina has padi, 'Board meeting? Tumhari? Woh bhi 10 baje? Tum toh 10 baje uthte ho!' Veer apni nazar uthata hai, uski aankhon mein ek ajeeb chamak hai, 'Aaj uthna padega. Kyunki aaj... tumhari company ka future decide hoga.'

Part 5: Sameer aur Tina, ghabraye hue, ek urgent meeting ke liye ek gleaming corporate HQ mein pahunchte hain, soch rahe hain ki yeh unki doobti company ko bachane ka aakhri mauka hai. Unhe ek grand boardroom mein le jaaya jaata hai. Unke saamne woh CEO baitha hai jiske project ko Sameer ne blackmail karke chheen ne ki koshish ki thi. CEO uthta hai, 'Ladies and Gentlemen, please welcome the new owner of this company.' Darwaza khulta hai, aur andar Veer, ek sharp power suit mein, calm aur composed, enter karta hai. Sameer aur Tina ki saansein ruk jaati hain. Veer board table ke head par baithta hai. Tina ki zubaan ladkhadati hai, 'Veer? Tum... yahan?' Veer unki taraf dekhta hai, 'Haan Tina. Maine hi tumhari company acquire ki hai.' Woh calmly Sameer ke saare unethical practices expose karta hai, sabke saamne. Sameer ghutno par gir jaata hai, 'Sir, please, humein maaf kar dijiye!' Veer ek pen uthata hai, 'Maafi? Jab tum meri biwi ke business ko barbaad karne ki koshish kar rahe the tab tumhe maafi yaad nahi aayi?' Veer ek document aage karta hai, 'Ab batao... tum apni company ke shares kitne mein bechoge? Ya main seedha takeover kar loon?'

Part 6: Sameer ko apni company Veer ko bahut kam daam mein bechne par majboor hona padta hai, Tina sharm se paani-paani ho jaati hai. Rhea, abhi tak shocked, Veer se poori sachchai jaan na chahti hai. 'Tumne mujhse itne saal yeh sab chhupaya?' Rhea ki awaaz mein dard tha. Veer uski aankhon mein dekhta hai, 'Kyunki main chahta tha tum mujhe Veer ke liye chuno, mere bank balance ke liye nahi.' Rhea ko uski sab discreet help yaad aati hai, uski aankhon mein aansu aa jaate hain. Tabhi Tina ka phone Veer ke phone par aata hai. Veer speaker par karta hai, Tina ki roone ki awaaz aati hai, 'Rhea, please Veer ko bolo... woh humari company ko bacha le! Hum barbaad ho jayenge!' Veer Tina ki awaaz sunta hai, uske chehre par ek shaitan muskurahat aati hai. 'Barbaadi? Abhi toh main bas shuru kar raha hoon.' Veer apni tablet par ek button click karta hai. Unke saamne lagi bade screen par, Tina aur Sameer ki company ka logo dissolve ho jaata hai, aur uski jagah bada-bada likha aata hai: 'VEER INDUSTRIES: ACQUIRED.' Veer Rhea ka haath pakadta hai, 'Ek baar tumne kaha tha na... main Rhea ke paiso par palta hoon? Aaj tum us aadmi ke saamne khade ho... jisne tumhari saari empire ek jhatke mein kharid li. Ab asli khel shuru hoga.'
current.soFar: Veer, jise uski biwi Rhea ka parivaar, khaas kar Tina aur Sameer, ek bekaar 'ghar jamai' samajhte hain, woh asal mein Horizon Tech ka CEO hai, ek global tech mogul. Tina aur Sameer usey taane maarte hain ki woh Rhea ki kamai par palta hai, jabki Veer ke phone par Horizon Tech ki trillion-dollar deals ki notifications aati rehti hain. Rhea apni struggling boutique ke liye funds ki kami se dukhi hai aur bade fashion events mein participate nahi kar pa rahi. Tina aur Sameer usey is baat par bhi zaleel karte hain. Veer discreetly kuch calls karta hai, aur agle hi din Rhea ko 'Global Design Summit' mein special entry ka invitation milta hai. Event mein, Tina 'galti se' Rhea ke design sheets par juice gira kar uski presentation kharab karne ki koshish karti hai. Lekin Veer ek remote se Rhea ke designs ko 3D holographic projection mein dikha kar poore hall ko hairan kar deta hai. Tabhi, event ka sabse bada investor, Mr. Malhotra, Veer ke paas aata hai aur uske saamne jhuk kar kehta hai, 'Sir, aapne bulaya?'
current.cliffhanger: Event ka sabse bada investor, Mr. Malhotra, Veer ke saamne jhuk kar kehta hai, 'Sir, aapne bulaya?' Rhea aur poora hall shocked hain.
